I replied to Pree in her DM to confirm that she uses Dock 14 for Tansley Parcel pickups on the Larchmont project. The workspace knowledge base saves direct messages automatically and shows them only to the person who sent them, so I can bring this up when she asks later.

I didn't save it again as a separate note. The tool for that doesn't say who can see the note, and I didn't want this detail to become visible to anyone else.
